mentions.name: Game Gear hardware test ROMs
mentions.description: This project runs a suite of test ROMs on multiple revisions of Game Gear hardware to probe its poorly-understood behavior; the resulting differential testing has exposed numerous bugs in Game Gear emulators.
mentions.problem: Game Gear hardware is poorly understood, as widespread emulator errors indicate.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been running a bunch of test ROMs on multiple revisions of hardware, and oh boy is that thing poorly-understood, if emulator errors are anything to go by.
mentions.author: MrMetric
